description.narrative: The purpose of the project is to enable learning and exchanges within the program, between other country programs or with other relevant actors, which will strenghten the partners capacity and contribute to the overall fulfillment of the program objective. The project will include an annual partners meeting, quality assurance including trainings, as well as provide possibilities for new initiatives and synergies surging from demands or ideas of local or Swedish programme partners.Project OrganisationsImplementing organisation is the Palme Center in collaboration with programme partners.Other Donors to the OrganisationNot applicableProject ObjectiveIncreased cooperation and coordination between the partners within the Philippine Programme as well as increasing their knowledge and understanding of project management and other thematic relevant issues.
